supersedes: reviewed-read-contract.json detail_read_catalogue DR-13 review_note (rejection of GET /external-parties/{id})
delta.gap: Proven gap. Reviewed DR-13 offers only GET /matters/{m}/external-parties (keyset, limit<=200 per page, no id filter); refs are {kind,id} without label; waits?partyId= filters waits, not the party. Synthetic counterexample: Matter with 201 parties ordered by label, referenced party is #201 -> it is on page 2; the client must scan pages sequentially to show its label or context. The prior YAGNI rejection of GET /external-parties/{id} does not hold
resolution: REINSTATE point lookup GET /api/v1/external-parties/{id} (REVIEWED_CANDIDATE), returning exactly the reviewed list-item fields: label, role/context, inactive, revision (+ asOf/sourceRevision)

GUARANTEED CONTEXT: every reviewed shape that emits an EXTERNAL_PARTY ref for display carries its label from the same snapshot: waitingOn card and DR-16 wait add partyLabel; DR-12 filing adds authorityPartyLabel

fields.note: null when the wait is on a condition, not a party

fields.path: GET /external-parties/{id} response {ref, label, roleContext, inactive, revision, asOf, sourceRevision}

delta.ref_shape: Unchanged {kind: EXTERNAL_PARTY, id}; labels are sibling fields, not part of the generic ref
delta.parent_context: None needed: the party belongs to exactly one Matter, which the server resolves
delta.collection_negative: List unchanged and still keyset paginated, no total cap assumed; a picker pages via cursor. Inactive parties stay resolvable (history) with inactive=true. Nonexistent, foreign-Matter, revoked and kind-mismatched ids -> uniform 404
acceptance: Clicking a partyRef from a wait/filing issues exactly one GET /external-parties/{id}; no list scan
Overview wait cards render party labels with no follow-up request
Party #201 in the synthetic 201-party Matter resolves in one request
Revoked member gets the same 404 as nonexistent; client purges cached party detail for that Matter
delta.authorization: RC-1/RC-3 unchanged: authentication (401) -> server resolves the owning Matter from the resource -> active Workspace AND explicit Matter membership AND O/E/V role, else uniform 404 byte-identical to nonexistent; other-kind id (e.g. a claimId on /evidence/{id}) -> same 404; no 403 on P0 reads; no Workspace OWNER implicit grant; no shared-token fallback
delta.snapshot_boundary: A point lookup is its own read boundary with asOf/sourceRevision; it never patches the overview snapshot. Labels embedded in overview cards come from the overview snapshot. If a lookup's sourceRevision is newer, show 'changed since overview'

supersedes: reviewed-read-contract.json detail_read_catalogue DR-09 required_data (adds claim envelope)
DR-15 events / recentChanges card shape (adds claimRef sibling for ASSESSMENT/DISPUTE targets)
delta.gap: Proven gap in consumer navigation context, not a corrupt stored claim. Reviewed DR-08 returns claims inline under GET /evidence/{evidenceId}; DR-09 GET /evidence-claims/{claimId}/assessments returns history only. An EVIDENCE_CLAIM ref arriving from an event targetRef, dispute or assessment carries no evidenceId, so the claim definition and parent are unreachable. Existing safe path only where the emitter already carries the parent: DR-07 claims summary {claimRef, evidenceRef}
resolution: EXTEND existing GET /api/v1/evidence-claims/{id}/assessments (REVIEWED_CANDIDATE, no new route): response always includes claim {claimRef, evidenceRef, criterionRevisionRef, componentKey|null, status, revision} plus assessments[] (may be [])
Consumer path for any standalone claimRef: GET /evidence-claims/{claimId}/assessments -> claim.evidenceRef -> GET /evidence/{evidenceId}. Never send a claimId to /evidence/{id}
The claim envelope is present on every page of the keyset-paged assessments collection, including continuation pages

ASSESSMENT and DISPUTE refs: candidate commands address these by their own ids (POST /evidence-assessments/{id}:revoke, /disputes, /disputes/{id}:resolve) and event target kinds are unspecified. Wherever such a ref is emitted (DR-15 event targetRef, recentChanges card), a sibling claimRef is carried; the consumer then uses the claim path. No new route or resolver for those kinds

fields.note: {claimRef, evidenceRef, criterionRevisionRef, componentKey|null, status, revision}; on every page
present when targetRef.kind is ASSESSMENT or DISPUTE; null otherwise

delta.parent_context: Guaranteed by the server: every claim has exactly one parent Evidence and one criterion revision (candidate api-contracts §1.1 'A claim has one criterion revision', §3.3 claims created under one Evidence), returned in claim.evidenceRef and claim.criterionRevisionRef. Exact assessedDocumentVersionRef stays on each assessment
delta.collection_negative: A claim with no assessments returns claim + assessments:[] (exists, unreviewed), distinct from 404. Withdrawn evidence keeps its claim resolvable with status shown. Nonexistent, foreign, revoked and kind-mismatched ids -> uniform 404. Current verification aggregate remains a separate backend projection
acceptance: A claimRef from recentChanges resolves to claim + parent evidence in at most two requests, without guessing ids
A claimId sent to /evidence/{id} returns 404 (RC-3); the consumer never does this
Zero-assessment claim renders as an existing claim with no review, not as not-found
After promotion the assessment keeps the exact assessedDocumentVersionRef (CT-12)
A dispute or assessment-revocation event in recentChanges resolves to its claim and parent evidence without guessed ids (CT-19)
